# He picks up the parachute (259) and the Rock (277) and steps off the ledge. The parachute opens (316), and
# he drifts right to 14 px from the shaft's right wall and throws the Rock up (332). It hits the wall at once
# and comes back at -4 px a step, rising, through the canopy (332-333): oParachute's collision with oItem
# tears it only if other.xVel > 0 or other.yVel > 0, and this Rock moves left and up, so it holds, and he
# floats down to land (364, oParaUsed). At the foot he picks up the second pair (418, 436), steps into the
# second shaft, and the parachute opens (479). This time he throws up from 12 px off the left wall (492): the
# Rock bounces back at +4, rising, through the canopy, which tears at once (oParaUsed), and he falls the rest
# of the way at up to 10 px a step.
